# hpe_opsramp_script_category (Resource)

Manages an OpsRamp RBA Script Category. Categories organize scripts and can be nested using `parent_id`.


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_opsramp_script_category" "network" {
  name      = "Network"
  parent_id = hpe_opsramp_script_category.automation.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the script category.

### Optional

- `client` (String) The client (tenant) UUID where this category should be created. If not specified, uses the provider's tenant.
- `parent_id` (String) Uuid of the parent category.

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the script category, assigned by OpsRamp.
